title: Return and Refund Policy
text: Customers may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the returned item.

title: Shipping and Delivery Times
text: Standard domestic orders arrive in 3 to 5 business days. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days depending on customs. Expedited overnight shipping is available at checkout for an additional fee.

title: AeroBook Pro X14 Technical Specifications
text: The AeroBook Pro X14 laptop, model ANX-14, ships with a 14 inch display, 16 GB of RAM, and a 512 GB solid-state drive. The ANX-14 uses an octa-core processor and supports up to 32 GB RAM on the higher configuration.

title: AeroBook Pro X14 Battery Troubleshooting
text: If your AeroBook Pro X14 battery drains quickly or will not hold a charge, recalibrate it by letting it discharge fully and then charging to one hundred percent. A worn battery that loses power rapidly may need replacement under warranty.

title: Warranty Coverage and Claims
text: All TechNova hardware includes a two-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. To file a claim, provide your serial number and proof of purchase. Accidental damage is not covered unless you purchased the protection plan.

title: Resetting Your Password
text: To restore access to your TechNova account, open the security page and choose Reset Password. A verification link is sent to your registered email. Pick a strong, unique password that you have not used before.

title: AeroBook Pro X14 Keyboard Backlight Settings
text: On the AeroBook Pro X14, model ANX-14, adjust the keyboard backlight with the function key and the brightness keys. You can set the backlight to turn off automatically after a period of inactivity to save battery.

title: Data Privacy and GDPR Compliance
text: TechNova processes personal data in accordance with GDPR and other applicable privacy regulations. Customers in the European Union may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their personal data at any time.

title: Bulk and Enterprise Ordering
text: Organizations purchasing more than fifty units qualify for volume pricing and a dedicated account manager. Enterprise customers can request consolidated invoicing and customized delivery schedules.

title: Recycling and Trade-In Program
text: Through our trade-in program you can send back an older device and receive store credit toward a new one. Returned electronics are refurbished or recycled responsibly so that hazardous materials are kept out of landfills.

title: SmartHub RX-450 Firmware Update
text: Firmware version 2.3 for the SmartHub RX-450 router improves connection stability and security. Install the RX-450 update from the admin dashboard and reboot the router to apply the changes.

title: SmartHub Slow Wireless Troubleshooting
text: If video streams keep buffering or your wireless signal feels weak and laggy, move the SmartHub closer to your devices and reduce interference from other electronics. Switching to the five gigahertz band often reduces dropouts.
